headword: {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}
gloss: drowsy driving; dozing at the wheel

definitions.gloss: drowsy driving; dozing at the wheel; falling asleep while driving
definitions.explanation: The dangerous act of falling asleep or nearly falling asleep while operating a vehicle. A major cause of traffic accidents.

examples.japanese: {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}は{非常|ひじょう}に{危険|きけん}だ。
{居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}で{事故|じこ}を{起|お}こしてしまった。
examples.english: I caused an accident by dozing off at the wheel.

examples.japanese: {長距離|ちょうきょり}ドライブでは{居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}を{防|ふせ}ぐために、こまめに{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: On long-distance drives, it is important to take frequent breaks to prevent drowsy driving.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {居眠|いねむ}り (dozing, nodding off) and {運転|うんてん} (driving). Used in news reports, traffic safety campaigns, and everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}による{事故|じこ} (accident caused by drowsy driving)
- {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}を{防止|ぼうし}する (to prevent drowsy driving)
- {居眠|いねむ}り{運転|うんてん}{防止|ぼうし}{装置|そうち} (drowsy driving prevention device)

RELATED WORDS:
- {飲酒|いんしゅ}{運転|うんてん}: drunk driving
- わき{見|み}{運転|うんてん}: distracted driving (looking away)
- {あおり}{運転|うんてん}: tailgating / road rage driving
